name: loreline-release
description: Release tooling only, not an application. Loreline is the Python package in src/loreline and the SvelteKit app in frontend/; neither is built or published from here. This file exists so commit-and-tag-version has somewhere to be installed from, and it deliberately carries no version field: the version of record is pyproject.toml. See docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Cutting a release'.
